releaseTitle: TikSave v1.1.5 (Zero-Timeout Parallel TikTok Resolver & Orbiting Star Border UI)
releaseNotes:
• Fixed 'Network error: timeout': New dual parallel TikTok extraction engine (Direct TikTok Universal Data + TikWM fast race) with IPv4-first DNS eliminates mobile carrier stalls and resolves links in ~1 second
• Shared Session CookieJar: Seamless 403-free in-app video previews and CDN downloads
• Orbiting Light & Star Border Animation: Futuristic glowing neon beam + twinkling traveling star around the TikTok Link Box
• Enhanced Smoothness: Streamlined animations, responsive feedback, and reliable background self-updater
• Original Production Keystore Preserved: Seamless self-update signed with verified CN=TikSave certificate
